prompts.question: Is this company listed in the Angel Association New Zealand (AANZ) network, either as an angel group member or as an investee company?
prompts.why_it_matters: Shows whether the company's funding story is tied to a recognised New Zealand early-stage investment network.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the AANZ member and portfolio listings and search them for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company, or the investment group backing it, appears in an AANZ member or portfolio listing.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search of the AANZ listings returns no match for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The AANZ listing pages cannot be searched or loaded, or the name is too generic to match.

prompts.question: Is this company listed by the Civil Aviation Authority of New Zealand (CAA) as a certificated organisation, such as a Part 119 or Part 121 air operator certificate holder?
prompts.why_it_matters: Confirms the company actually holds the aviation approvals needed for any air operation it claims.

source.name: Civil Aviation Authority of New Zealand (CAA)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the CAA list of certificated organisations and scan the Part 119 and Part 121 entries for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears on a CAA certificated organisations list with a certificate number.
prompts.not_found_when: The company name is absent from the relevant CAA certificated organisation lists after a clean scan.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The CAA list pages are unreadable or not loaded in full, or the name is too common to match.

prompts.question: Does this company have a Builderscrack profile showing completed jobs and verified client reviews?
prompts.why_it_matters: Reveals how the company is rated by paying customers and whether its claimed trade history is backed by records.
prompts.how_to_query: Use Builderscrack's trades search and enter the company name as the search term.
prompts.found_when: The company has a Builderscrack trade profile with jobs, ratings or client reviews.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean Builderscrack search returns no profile for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Builderscrack search is unavailable or returns many similarly named trades that cannot be separated.

prompts.question: Has BusinessDesk published any news article naming this company?
prompts.why_it_matters: Surfaces financial, regulatory or executive news about the company that may contradict its own story.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the BusinessDesk site search and enter the company name in quotes.
prompts.found_when: One or more BusinessDesk articles name the company.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean BusinessDesk search returns no article naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search index is unavailable or the name is too common to match reliably.

prompts.question: Is this company listed in the Canterbury Employers' Chamber of Commerce (The Chamber) member directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: Shows whether the company is an active, dues-paying member of the South Island's main business body.

source.name: Canterbury Employers' Chamber of Commerce (The Chamber)

prompts.how_to_query: Use the Chamber's member directory search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company has a directory listing as a Chamber member.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean directory search returns no listing for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member directory is unavailable or the name matches too many unrelated listings.

prompts.question: Is this organisation registered on the Charities Services Register (Ngā Ratonga Kaupapa Atawhai)?
prompts.why_it_matters: Checks whether any charitable or tax-donee status the organisation claims is real and current.

source.name: Charities Services Register (Ngā Ratonga Kaupapa Atawhai)

prompts.how_to_query: Use the Charities Register search and enter the organisation's legal name.
prompts.found_when: The organisation appears on the register with a registration number and status.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean register search returns no entry for the organisation.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register search fails or the organisation name is too generic to match a single entry.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in the Commerce Commission New Zealand case register?
prompts.why_it_matters: Shows whether the company has been investigated, warned or taken to court over fair trading or competition conduct.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the Commerce Commission case register using the company name.
prompts.found_when: One or more case register entries name the company.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean case register search returns no entries for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The case register search is unavailable or returns too many unrelated matches to attribute.

prompts.question: Does this company appear on the New Zealand Companies Register (Companies Office), and is its recorded status (registered, removed or in liquidation) confirmed?
prompts.why_it_matters: Establishes the company's real legal existence, directors and status behind the name used in business.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the Companies Register by company name or number and open the company summary page.
prompts.found_when: The company has a register entry with a company number and a recorded status.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean register search returns no company with that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register is unavailable or several same-named companies cannot be told apart.

prompts.question: Does this company appear as a party in any Employment Relations Authority (ERA) determination?
prompts.why_it_matters: Flags employment disputes, wage arrears or penalty orders that show how the company treats staff.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the ERA determinations search and enter the company name in the Parties field.
prompts.found_when: One or more determinations list the company as a party.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean determinations search returns no result for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The determinations search is down or the name is too common to match a single employer.

prompts.question: Is this company registered on the Financial Service Providers Register (FSPR) for the financial services it offers?
prompts.why_it_matters: Confirming a valid FSPR entry shows the company may legally provide the financial services it advertises.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the FSPR register search and enter the company or trading name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears as an FSPR-registered provider with listed financial services.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean FSPR search returns no registered provider with that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The FSPR search is unavailable or the name matches several unrelated providers.

prompts.question: Has this company been the subject of a statutory notice in The New Zealand Gazette (Te Kāhiti o Aotearoa), such as a liquidation, receivership or strike-off notice?
prompts.why_it_matters: Official insolvency or strike-off notices reveal serious financial or legal trouble the company may not disclose.

source.name: The New Zealand Gazette (Te Kāhiti o Aotearoa)

prompts.how_to_query: Use the Gazette keyword search and enter the company name in quotes.
prompts.found_when: One or more Gazette notices name the company.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean Gazette keyword search returns no notice for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The Gazette search is unavailable or the name is too common to attribute notices confidently.

prompts.question: Is this company listed as a member or affiliate of Hospitality New Zealand?
prompts.why_it_matters: Membership supports claims of industry standing and access to the association's compliance guidance.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Hospitality New Zealand affiliate and member directory filter and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the Hospitality New Zealand member or affiliate listing.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean member directory search returns no listing for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member directory filter is unavailable or the name is too generic to match.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in the Insolvency and Trustee Service public registers of insolvency estates?
prompts.why_it_matters: Personal insolvency of directors or the company itself is a strong signal of financial risk to counterparties.

source.name: Insolvency and Trustee Service Public Registers

prompts.how_to_query: Use the Insolvency and Trustee Service public register search and enter the company or director name.
prompts.found_when: The company or its named director appears in an insolvency estate record.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean register search returns no estate record for the company or director.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register search is down or the name is too common to match a person or company.

prompts.question: Has Interest.co.nz published any news or analysis article naming this company?
prompts.why_it_matters: Financial press coverage can expose liquidation, covenant or funding problems the company does not publicise.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Interest.co.nz site search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: One or more Interest.co.nz articles name the company.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean Interest.co.nz search returns no article naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site search is unavailable or the name is too common to match reliably.

prompts.question: Is this organisation registered on the Incorporated Societies and Trusts Register?
prompts.why_it_matters: Confirms whether a group claiming society or trust status actually exists and is currently registered.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the Incorporated Societies and Trusts Register by the society or trust name.
prompts.found_when: The organisation appears on the register with a registration number and status.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean register search returns no entry for the organisation.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register search is unavailable or the name is too generic to match one entity.

prompts.question: Is this company licensed by the Private Security Personnel Licensing Authority (PSPLA) for the security services it offers?
prompts.why_it_matters: Security work requires a PSPLA licence, so absence points to an unlicensed or misrepresented operator.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the PSPLA public register on the justice.govt.nz site by company or trading name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears with an issued permit and licence class on the PSPLA register.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean PSPLA search returns no licence for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The PSPLA register search fails or the trading name is too generic to match.

prompts.question: Does this company appear as an applicant in the Overseas Investment Office (OIO) Decisions Register held by LINZ?
prompts.why_it_matters: OIO decisions show whether foreign-owned or sensitive acquisitions were consented to, declined or conditioned.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the LINZ OIO decisions search and enter the applicant company name.
prompts.found_when: A decision summary lists the company as applicant with an outcome.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean OIO decisions search returns no decision for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The decisions search is unavailable or the name is too common to attribute a decision.

prompts.question: Is this company listed as a member on the Registered Master Builders Association 'Check your Builder' search?

prompts.question: Does this company appear on Medsafe's licensed medicine manufacturers list or in its approved medicines and medical device records?
